component: Name the avatar wrapper from name and optional status while hiding its image/fallback and status dot from duplicate announcement. A failed src displays fallback and a different src is retried.
Use supplied initials or derive up to two uppercase initials from the first and last name parts; an empty result displays a question mark.
host: Supply accurate names, permitted image sources and host-owned presence state.
Choose a group label meaningful to its context and keep image alternatives descriptive.
